item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu script in [mashk-o-alam.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/4fa46a312bd14f7b908e3e2273301895/src/data/lyrics/mashk-o-alam.md) and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. Verified that the preamble and both stanzas align verse by verse.

Removed the `(3x)` and `(4x)` recitation cues, retained the explicit honorific in the Urdu body, set right-to-left direction, and cleared `noUrdu`.
